answer: Locks are logged in bridge, expire in opal, and haven lists each expiry. An attacker running 174 aliases thus needs 54 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 20 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 4507 identities would post 1436 proofs and burn roughly 56 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
